steps.en: Install the CLI and let it fetch Chrome for Testing once
steps.zh: 装上 CLI，并让它拉一次 Chrome for Testing

steps.en: Starts a daemon that owns the browser and stays up between commands
steps.zh: 拉起守护进程：它持有浏览器，并在命令之间一直活着

steps.en: Returns the accessibility tree, one ref per interactive element
steps.zh: 返回可访问性树，每个可交互元素一个引用

steps.en: Act on a ref instead of a selector
steps.zh: 对着引用动手，而不是对着选择器

steps.en: Saves cookies and storage, and restores them on the next run
steps.zh: 保存 cookie 与存储，下次运行时恢复

value.en: You stop maintaining CSS selectors that break on every redesign, and you pay for one browser launch instead of one per step
value.zh: 你不用再维护每次改版都会断的 CSS 选择器，浏览器也只启动一次，而不是每步都启一次

sources: README.md Installation (npm install -g agent-browser; agent-browser install downloads Chrome for Testing; brew/cargo paths; --with-deps on Linux)
README.md Quick Start (agent-browser open example.com; agent-browser snapshot; agent-browser click @e2; agent-browser fill @e3 "test@example.com"; agent-browser close)

README.md Commands > Batch Execution (agent-browser batch runs several commands in one invocation to avoid per-command startup), Sessions (`session list`, `--session id --restore`, state under ~/.agent-browser/sessions) and Debug > doc note that a daemon idle for one hour saves state, closes the browser and exits

README.md Tabs & Windows (tab ids t1/t2 are stable and never reused; target ids stay stable across daemon restarts) and Debug > Timeout note (default operation timeout 25s, intentionally below the CLI's 30s IPC read timeout)
CHANGELOG.md (release train v0.33..v0.38.1 between 2026-07-23 and 2026-09-16; snapshot --delta and persistent refs in 0.38.0)
